# Bitfroest.fs 0.0.51

Changes since version [0.0.50](https://github.com/s-a/Bitfroest.fs/releases/tag/v0.0.50).

## Added

- Quick Diff compares saved file content with HEAD in a read-only inline preview. The footer button cycles through the current folder and its subfolders, the entire repository, and off. The preview uses 60% of the width; the file list uses 40% and shows root-relative paths, status and local file modification times. Full-width filenames appear above a compact status · relative time · root-relative directory line. Filenames use the normal theme foreground without file icons; only status labels use Git colors. The remaining metadata uses the readable theme foreground. Name, status and date remain sortable. Filename and directory tooltips show the complete file path. Ctrl+Y copies the selected file path; Ctrl+Shift+Y copies it with forward slashes. Localized relative modification times have exact-date tooltips. The default order is Modified, Added, then Deleted, with newest files first within each status and unavailable timestamps last within their status.
- Unchanged sections collapse with three context lines and can be expanded. Quick Diff uses a narrow change overview without a minimap. The preview title counts added (+), changed (~) and deleted (−) lines without double-counting changed lines. Text can be copied, and double-clicking opens the same comparison in the native VS Code diff editor.
- Quick Diff includes new files and excludes ignored files. Both modes use native path separators, no redundant directory marker for root-level files, and Git status colors for status labels. New files appear as syntax-highlighted additions against an empty original; deleted files show the HEAD content as removed lines. Each text version is limited to 5 MiB by default, configurable with `bitfroest.files.quickDiffMaxFileSizeMiB`.

- X-Ray previews text files in the opposite pane with syntax highlighting and a complete minimap. The eye button cycles through off, preview on click, and X-Ray Ultra on hover after 200 ms. Right-clicking the eye turns the preview off.
- Preview text can be selected and copied with Ctrl+C or the context menu. Double-clicking a text line opens the original file at that line in VS Code. The line under the pointer receives a subtle background highlight.
- The preview receives 60% of the width. Its source list temporarily shows only filenames and icons, with footer counts and size hidden. Turning X-Ray off restores the previous layout and columns.
- The maximum preview file size defaults to 5 MiB and can be changed in Settings with `bitfroest.files.xrayMaxFileSizeMiB`.

## Improved

- Pane footers place controls on the left and file counts, folder counts and size on the right.
- Two walkthroughs demonstrate X-Ray and X-Ray Ultra.
- The inline rename walkthrough records delayed-click and F2 interactions, both canceled without changing the sample file. Recordings include pointer movement, click pulses and keyboard hints. A WebM download accompanies the GIF in the feature gallery.

## Fixed

- Quick Diff uses a clear File Name heading. After opening a file in its directory with a double-click, History Back restores the previous Quick Diff scope, selection, sorting and scroll position. History tooltips identify Quick Diff destinations.
- Quick Diff keeps its file list and footer controls intact when the host refreshes the pane. Double-clicking a list entry leaves Quick Diff and selects the file in its directory; deleted files open their directory with a missing-file notice.

- X-Ray can be activated with a mouse click after switching focus between panes.
- Right-clicking a pane footer no longer opens a file context menu.

## Known limitations

- Quick Diff requires the built-in Git extension and Git. It compares saved content; unsaved editor changes are excluded. Renames appear as a deletion and an addition. Archives, binary files, sparse checkouts and skip-worktree entries are excluded.
- Git API reads return HEAD content as a complete buffer. Object size is checked before the call and returned size is validated afterward; repository text conversions that change the byte size are rejected. Git API reads already in progress cannot be interrupted. Their results are discarded after cancellation; the activity remains pending until the call returns. Filesystem refresh events follow the host watcher exclusions; the Refresh command explicitly reloads Quick Diff.

- X-Ray reads the complete file. Archives, archive entries and binary content are excluded. Content detection is heuristic.
- Syntax highlighting covers JSON, SQL, PowerShell, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, XML, YAML, shell scripts and Markdown; other files appear as plain text. Extremely long lines retain Monaco’s tokenization safeguards. Installed VS Code language extensions and custom token themes are not automatically reused.
- Native showcase captures cover Windows with a dark theme. Other platforms and themes have no native visual acceptance for this feature.
- No settings migration is required.
